constraints: This overlay is answer blind and never reads benchmark labels or patient identifiers.
HAP or an airway device changes review priority but does not identify a pathogen by itself.
Eligibility requires a versioned taxonomy profile with both healthcare-associated and pulmonary-pathogen-possible traits; the policy contains no organism-name allowlist.
Only a positive lower-respiratory candidate already in Context and ranked within the top three may move to Priority.
Explicit exact-organism colonization or current-not-infection evidence blocks promotion.
At most one representative per patient may move, and a candidate already changed by another history rule cannot move again.
This overlay never creates Picked and does not alter the separate aspiration Picked gate.
Missing evidence is unknown and is never interpreted as negative evidence.
